name: Shipping chokepoints
value: 22+ attacks in Nov; 3 tankers hit 20–21 Nov
summary: At least 22 attacks on shipping near Hormuz in November, per UKMTO data; a tanker incident with forces on 22 Nov
state: UKMTO data show at least 22 reported attacks on shipping in the region in November as of 22 Nov, after more than 30 in October. Before October the average was about 10 a month. Projectiles hit three tankers leaving the Strait of Hormuz on 20–21 Nov (CNN via WISH-TV). On 22 Nov UKMTO reported a tanker incident with military forces in the Gulf of Oman near Chabahar, and Iranian media said two supertankers caught fire after hitting mines east of the strait (Euronews). Repeated attacks keep Hormuz traffic materially impeded.
for_you: Shipping, insurance and energy supply chains through the Gulf face continuing disruption, which tends to feed through to fuel and freight costs. Mariners should follow UKMTO and JMIC advisories; travellers should check FCDO travel advice for the region.
rubric_hit: Alert: Hormuz traffic materially impeded (UKMTO: 22+ attacks in Nov, 30+ in Oct)

sources.title: WISH-TV (CNN) — Reported attacks on shipping near Strait of Hormuz hit wartime high
Euronews — Tanker incident 'involving military forces' reported in Strait of Hormuz

why: Around 30% of seaborne oil and much container trade passes Hormuz, Bab el-Mandeb/Suez, Panama and Malacca; disruption raises prices worldwide.
drivers: Houthi/Iran attacks, war-risk insurance, drought (Panama), naval incidents, piracy.

rubric.alert: Hormuz traffic materially impeded, or any chokepoint closed, or two or more disrupted at once.
rubric.watch: One chokepoint disrupted (attacks, large-scale diversions, draught restrictions).
